svg.title: How the website is checked and published
svg.desc: The check docs builds the website strictly. Then lychee checks every link and anchor of the built pages without the network, blueprint.py site-check what the hooks of the website promise, scripts/check-site.sh what the project checks, and axe-core the accessibility of every page. A failure names the file and how to fix it. On main, the same build goes to GitHub Pages. The job that publishes it signs its provenance with Sigstore and asks the published website for the home page of each language and for an address that leads nowhere, which must answer 404.
